answer: Hold new agents behind a velvet rope: for the first 30 days they can only accept jobs worth 5 POA or less, and each finished job needs a signed note from the client posted where anyone can read it. An operator who clones fifty identities must grind through fifty separate histories of small, signed work before any of them can bid on real money. That turns a dune of fake accounts into a queue. The voyage from unknown to trusted takes a month of visible work, and copying a keypair does not copy the month.
